_comment: Copy to mapping.json and set node ids/titles from YOUR exported API workflow. Target a node by "node" (its id in the API json) OR by "title" (its _meta.title). Placeholders: $prompt $seed $steps $num_frames $width $height. Only list fields you want to override; anything you leave out keeps the workflow's own value (so turbo 8-step stays 8 if you don't map steps). 'from' on images is 'first' or 'last'.
